text: Could you make a post for a little houseplant shop, with lots of lush potted houseplants? I have a soft spot for little plant shops, so I’m probably overthinking how to explain this. It’s for an Instagram feed, and the headline should be exactly “Bring home some green”. I’d like a clean cream background behind all the plants. I’m a little worried my rambling makes this sound more complicated than it is. There should be no other text besides that headline.
